input.subject: R/025 – kitchen tap, 18 Thistlewick Row – invoice query
input.body:
Dear Mr Bell,

This is an update on the dripping kitchen tap at 18 Thistlewick Row, Fenmere, ZZ1 1ZZ (our ref R/025). We have received a document from Bracken & Vale Plumbing that refers to a new mono kitchen sink tap. It doesn't show any cost, and we never received a quote from them.

We have asked the contractor for a fully priced invoice and asked the tenant to tell us how things stand at the property. When we have the amount, we will send you the details to confirm before anything is paid. You don't need to do anything for now.

The tenant has also reported a loose top kitchen drawer with broken front brackets. We will contact you about that separately.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

Bracken & Vale Plumbing was booked for 10 Sept. Their corrected invoice NBL-025-INV-15 has the right postcode and covers supplying and installing a new mono sink tap, but it shows no amount, VAT, total or work date. I have asked the tenant whether the plumber attended, whether the drip has stopped and whether the water is still cloudy. I have told the landlord the invoice is on hold pending an amount.
